title: Finite type is preserved by affine module correspondence
statement: Let $u:U\to X$ be affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], let $\mathcal A=u_*\mathcal O_U$, and let $\mathcal M$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal A$-module. Then $\mathcal M$ is of finite type over $\mathcal A$ if and only if the corresponding quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module under [lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-correspondence] is of finite type. Here quasi-coherence and finite type over a sheaf of algebras mean locally a presentation by free modules and locally a surjection from a finite free module, respectively [pqf-def-coherent].
